paths.rehype-raw: Turns HTML source in Markdown into live elements. The public /start page is NOT at risk: it renders through components/Landing/LandingMarkdown.tsx, which has its own plugin list and runs rehype-sanitize. The risk here is chat — agent output, tool transcripts and other users' messages rendered to signed-in users. If you genuinely need this, add rehype-sanitize in the same commit, and do not point /start back at the chat renderer. A signpost only, not enforcement: this repo has no CI. The boundary is the render path in LandingMarkdown.tsx.
